annotations.title: Audit a KiCad netlist against extracted datasheets

description: Audit a KiCad netlist against the datasheets your account has extracted with DatasheetVend. Compares symbol names with the datasheet, checks every pin exists, supply and ground pins sit on rails of the right kind and voltage, NC pins are left open, pin functions agree across each net, and pull-ups and the electrical rules that have data to run. `verdict` says how many pins were really compared and `rule_coverage` which rules could not run; a part with no matching extraction is reported as unmapped, never guessed. Deterministic: runs DatasheetVend's checks in code, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

job_ids.description: Extraction jobs in your account to audit the netlist against (1-12), one or more per part.

netlist.description: The KiCad netlist as exported: the s-expression .net or the XML form (at most 2 MB).

system_voltage_v.description: Used only where no net name states a voltage. Default 3.3.
